pll2d15c1-d1e3520.summary: Explains Gen 1:20: the fifth day's work is the formation of fish and birds, adorning two elements; God made both from water, raising birds into the air and sending swimmers into the deep.
claims: Fish and birds were made from water.

pl-l2d15c1.summary: Describes the fifth day's work: the formation of fish and birds, adorning water and air, both made from the same matter, water, birds raised into the air and fish sent back into the deep (Gen 1:20).
claims: The fifth day formed fish and birds.
Fish and birds were both made from water.
